Mini apps

Open a website inside Mayday, configure permissions, and read context in JavaScript.

On this page
  • Connect a website to a bot
  • Read the Mayday context
  • Profile and data permissions

Connect a website to a bot

  1. Prepare a page with a public HTTPS address.
  2. In Mayday for Android, go to Services → Bots → My bots. Choose Mini app for an existing bot or create a bot for your website.
  3. Enter a name and HTTPS address. Save your settings and use the mini app button in the bot chat to open it.

Read the Mayday context

Mayday for Android provides window.Mayday when it opens your mini app. Mayday.ready() returns context, including the user interface language and theme, the app, and the bot. This example displays the mini app name and leaves a hint in a regular browser.

<p id="status">Open this page from your bot chat in Mayday.</p>
<script>
  if (window.Mayday) {
    const status = document.querySelector('#status');
    Mayday.ready()
      .then(({ app }) => { status.textContent = app.name; })
      .catch(() => { status.textContent = 'Could not load Mayday.'; });
  }
</script>

Profile and data permissions

Mayday.requestAuth({ challenge }) requests sign-in and access to the public profile with the user’s consent. Enable the Sign in and profile permission in your mini app settings.

Mayday.sendData(data) sends a string or JSON data of up to 4096 bytes after serialization. Enable Data for this bot. The user confirms each submission.
